payload.notes: Dev-exe renamed plo6_trainer.exe -> GrindersVaultTrainer.exe so it no longer shares a process name with the signed customer v3.1.1 build (whose anti-tamper self-terminated on the collision, blocking that app). Installers now sweep the old exe on upgrade. Also hardens the GLFW launch path against the VNC/mirror-monitor crash. No feature or licensing change.
